rationale.edition: All three changed paths sit under tests/ui-testing/ (a ci-matrix shard config, a Traces page-object, and a Traces E2E spec). None are under o2_enterprise/, enterprise/, or any enterprise-owned directory, and no enterprise keywords appear in the changed paths, so this is an open-source (oss) change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change is test-only, but it adds a new Playwright E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Traces/, and dev-authored E2E tests are not an automatic skip — they route to 'enhance'. No skip label, opt-out marker, or triggering comment is present.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted via the enhance route: the dev-authored spec exercises user-facing Traces UI flows (RED metrics chart rendering, the charts toggle, zoom-to-filter, and the Insights drawer handoff), so the Architect should review and extend it.
rationale.area: Traces. The new spec lives in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Traces/ and the page-object additions are in tracesPages/tracesPage.js, targeting the Traces RED metrics charts and the Traces Insights dashboard.
rationale.group: The diff inserts tracesCharts.spec.js into the run_files of the shard whose testfolder is 'Traces' (the one already holding traceAdvancedFiltering, tracesAnalyzeDimensions, traceGenAiParts, etc.), so playwright_group is 'Traces'.
rationale.existing_tests: The diff adds tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Traces/tracesCharts.spec.js, a new Playwright E2E spec covering the Traces RED chart rendering, zoom, and Insights handoff. The tracesPage.js change is a supporting page-object and ci_matrix.json is shard config; the sole E2E spec in the diff is tracesCharts.spec.js.
